acceptanceCriteria: The instructions result summary for AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md is the document title or declared purpose, independent of section order, with a test.
body: Found during the Beamfall Corvint setup rollout (2026-10-20, corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676). After adding a '## Corvint context' section to AGENTS.md, `corvint impact AGENTS.md` summarised the instructions result as 'Before editing, read `corvint context ...`' rather than the document's title/purpose.
title: impact instructions result summary uses the first body line of a section instead of the document title or purpose
